rv.q: While Bev wants to settle down and become a mother, Terry is – as she sings – a “family of one”, resistant to monogamy and uncompromising in her activism.

A riotous brand new, vibrant musical from Sheffield that assembles commitment, inspiration and genuine entertainment and will fire you up to stand up for your rights. Sheffield has a proud tradition of creative innovation, especially in the field of home-grown musicals rooted in the history and culture of this great city.

The ensemble work is the show’s standout strength. The cast move and sing together with an easy, affectionate rhythm, forging a genuine connection with the audience. Musically, the show hums with Northern Soul energy – unpretentious and full of life.
